distribution.narrative: Cognato et al. (2024) documents verified specimens and molecular vouchers from Guangdong, Hainan and Hong Kong, supporting presence in mainland China and Hong Kong. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: The revision reports Bombacaceae and Litsea glutinosa. Litsea glutinosa is tied to the Hainan voucher; Bombacaceae is reported in the species treatment.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Sueus pilosus (Eggers, 1936).

taxonomic_history.name: Sueus pilosus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Sueus pilosus (Eggers, 1936) is restored from synonymy with S. niisimai based on reciprocal monophyly, greater than 10% COI divergence and diagnostic morphology.
